scripts.build: tsc && vite build && rm -f dist/data/victoria-* dist/data/winnipeg-*
scripts.build:victoria: VITE_CITY=victoria tsc && VITE_CITY=victoria vite build && rm -f dist/data/metro-* dist/data/vancouver-* dist/data/new-westminster-* dist/data/winnipeg-*
scripts.build:winnipeg: VITE_CITY=winnipeg tsc && VITE_CITY=winnipeg vite build && rm -f dist/data/metro-* dist/data/vancouver-* dist/data/new-westminster-* dist/data/victoria-*
scripts.deploy: npm run build && echo vancouver.treemap.ca > dist/CNAME && rm -rf node_modules/.cache/gh-pages && gh-pages -d dist
scripts.deploy:victoria: npm run build:victoria && echo victoria.treemap.ca > dist/CNAME && rm -rf node_modules/.cache/gh-pages && gh-pages -d dist -r git@github.com:tccw/victoria-bc-treemap-deploy-repo.git
scripts.deploy:winnipeg: npm run build:winnipeg && echo winnipeg.treemap.ca > dist/CNAME && rm -rf node_modules/.cache/gh-pages && gh-pages -d dist -r git@github.com:tccw/winnipeg-bc-treemap-deploy-repo.git
scripts.postinstall: cp node_modules/sql.js/dist/sql-wasm.wasm public/sql-wasm.wasm && mkdir -p public/data && cp data/vancouver-all-trees-id-to-location-map.db public/data/
